milestones.title: The runner extracts hidden parts of plain text, Markdown and staff product documents
Ingest extracts the hidden parts of the file formats it accepts

remediation: assess() reads the visible text and the hidden parts it is given; white-on-white text, tiny fonts, PDF layers and office document metadata reach it only if the caller extracts them. Phase 74.3-03 extracts plain text, Markdown (HTML comments, zero-width text, image alt text, front matter) and staff product documents with their comments; ingested files of other formats are Phase 93's. Source: 70.1-CONTEXT.md D-19; research 3.6.
title: The classification engine sees only the hidden parts its caller extracts
